publisher: City of Toronto — Toronto Municipal Code
title: Chapter 441, Fees and Charges, Appendix D — Schedule 1, Water & Wastewater Consumption Rates
archive_note: Text layer of the statutory schedule. The document date of 11 February 2025 is printed in the footer of all eleven pages, which is how we know this is the 2025 version and not the current one.
establishes: The metered residential consumption rate under the version dated 11 February 2025: CAD 4.6872 per m3 paid on or before the due date, 4.9338 after
That the instrument is titled 'Water & Wastewater Consumption Rates' and that Ref 1 is the entire metered residential rate — the combined nature is the title of the schedule, not an inference

The absence of any recurring fixed charge on a metered residential account, by enumeration: Schedule 1 carries one per-cubic-metre figure and every Schedule 2 fee is a one-off event or applies to customers who refuse a meter
That flat-rate and unmetered customers are priced per room and per fixture, and are a different reference customer
does_not_establish: The 2026 rate. This version predates the 1 January 2026 increase. 4.6872 x 1.0375 = 4.862970, which rounds to 4.8630 and truncates to 4.8629; the circulating figure is 4.8629, consistent with truncation but not evidence of it.

A water-only rate. Schedule 3 Ref 2 prices a sewer surcharge on private water at 57% of Block 1, which invites a 43/57 decomposition. Refused under Rule 3.3: that is the rate for a customer who draws water privately, not a statement that the domestic rate divides in that proportion.
The tax treatment. HST is named against technical review fees in the same instrument and not against the consumption rates; that differential is suggestive and is not a source.
